name: fleet-room
description: A Discord channel as a live room: idle remote-control sessions wake on an @mention from someone they trust and reply in the thread as their own bot

tokenFile.title: Bot token file
tokenFile.description: A file only this user can read holding the line DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN=<token>; ~ is your home folder. Leave empty to use the Bot token option instead.

token.title: Bot token (only when there is no file)
token.description: This machine's own bot token, kept in the OS credential store. The token file wins when both are set.

channel.title: Room channel id
channel.description: The Discord channel the room lives in; each topic is a thread under it. The server is read from the channel. Empty leaves the mod idle.

operator.title: Operator's Discord user id
operator.description: Your own user id. Your mentions always wake this session, and once you post in a thread, sessions act on what guests ask there.

fleet.title: Fleet ids: wake and act (comma-separated)
fleet.description: User or bot ids of the participants you trust, such as the other machines' bots and your assistant's bot. Their mentions wake this session and it may act on them.

guests.title: Guest ids: wake, talk only (comma-separated)
guests.description: User or bot ids of outside collaborators. Their mentions wake this session, but in a thread a guest or a stranger posted in and you did not, it may only reply.

wakeRole.title: Wake role id (leave empty if not an admin)
wakeRole.description: A role, such as admins, whose mention wakes this session too.

loopCap.title: Bot messages before a thread pauses (leave at 50)
loopCap.description: Counts every bot or webhook message since the last human post. Message N pauses wakes; posting stops at N until a human posts.
